violations.reason: The reservation details at step 7 show reservation 05XIX4 is an economy reservation created on 2024-05-01, and the user stated the reason for cancellation was a change of plans at steps 9 and 11. None of the permitted cancellation conditions is met: the booking is not within 24 hours, there is no airline cancellation, it is not a business flight, and travel insurance covers cancellation only for health or weather reasons, not a change of plans. Despite this, the agent called cancel_reservation at step 13, violating the requirement to ensure the cancellation rules apply before calling the API.
